summary: Free course with code that teaches you to design, build, deploy and improve production-grade machine learning applications.

heroCommands.command:
git clone https://github.com/GokuMohandas/Made-With-ML.git .
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Made With ML is a free course, with this repository as its code, on combining machine learning with software engineering. It walks from experimentation to production: designing, developing, deploying and iterating on a real ML application.
sixtySeconds.problem: Many ML tutorials stop at a notebook. This course teaches the engineering around the model, such as testing, scaling, serving and iteration, so you can ship reliable ML systems.
whoFor: Data scientists who want production skills
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a first-principles course with best practices and code you can run, joined by over 40,000 developers according to the README.

overview: Lessons live on madewithml.com and the code lives here. The course goes from design and development to deployment and iteration, building understanding from first principles before writing code.
It emphasises software engineering best practices and scaling ML workloads (data, training, tuning and serving) in Python.
Setup clones the repository into your own copy, creates a virtual environment and installs requirements. The repository is MIT licensed.
limitations: Some steps assume your own GitHub repository and cluster setup

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Made With ML's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Clone the code
steps.body: The README suggests first creating your own GitHub repository named Made-With-ML with a README.

steps.title: Create a virtual environment
steps.code:
export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:$PWD
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.code:
python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

firstRun.title: Open the lessons
firstRun.body: Go to madewithml.com and start with the first lesson while following along in the code.
